targets.rawSql:
SELECT cs.id_session::text AS session_id, COALESCE(r.reference_code, '-') AS code_reservation, COALESCE(u.pseudo, '-') AS utilisateur, s.nom AS station, b.nom AS borne, e.numero AS emplacement, cs.charge_state AS etat_charge, cs.start_time AS debut, cs.end_time AS fin, CASE WHEN cs.end_time IS NULL THEN ROUND(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (now() - cs.start_time)) / 60)::integer ELSE ROUND(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (cs.end_time - cs.start_time)) / 60)::integer END AS duree_min
FROM charging_session cs
JOIN reservation r ON r.id_reservation = cs.id_reservation
LEFT JOIN utilisateur u ON u.id_user = r.id_user
JOIN emplacement e ON e.id_emplacement = cs.id_emplacement
JOIN borne b ON b.id_borne = e.id_borne
JOIN station s ON s.id_station = e.id_station
WHERE cs.id_session::text = '${session:raw}';

SELECT st.timestamp AS time, st.courant AS value
FROM session_telemetry st
WHERE st.id_session::text = '${session:raw}' AND $__timeFilter(st.timestamp)
ORDER BY st.timestamp;

SELECT st.timestamp AS time, st.tension AS value
FROM session_telemetry st
WHERE st.id_session::text = '${session:raw}' AND $__timeFilter(st.timestamp)
ORDER BY st.timestamp;

SELECT st.timestamp AS time, (st.courant * st.tension) AS value
FROM session_telemetry st
WHERE st.id_session::text = '${session:raw}' AND $__timeFilter(st.timestamp)
ORDER BY st.timestamp;

SELECT st.timestamp AS time, st.energie_kwh AS value
FROM session_telemetry st
WHERE st.id_session::text = '${session:raw}' AND $__timeFilter(st.timestamp)
ORDER BY st.timestamp;

WITH selected_session AS (
  SELECT cs.id_emplacement, cs.start_time, COALESCE(cs.end_time, now()) AS end_time
  FROM charging_session cs
  WHERE cs.id_session::text = '${session:raw}'
)
SELECT cd.timestamp AS time, c.type AS metric, cd.valeur AS value
FROM capteur_data cd
JOIN capteur c ON c.id_capteur = cd.id_capteur
JOIN device d ON d.id_device = c.id_device
JOIN selected_session ss ON ss.id_emplacement = d.id_emplacement
WHERE c.type IN ('temperature', 'humidity')
  AND cd.timestamp BETWEEN ss.start_time AND ss.end_time
  AND $__timeFilter(cd.timestamp)
ORDER BY cd.timestamp;

panels.title: Température et humidité pendant la session

targets.rawSql:
SELECT dcl.timestamp AS time, dcl.action, dcl.status AS statut, dcl.message, dcl.command_id, dcl.source
FROM device_command_log dcl
WHERE dcl.id_session::text = '${session:raw}' AND $__timeFilter(dcl.timestamp)
ORDER BY dcl.timestamp DESC
LIMIT 50;

WITH selected_session AS (
  SELECT cs.id_session, cs.id_emplacement, cs.start_time, COALESCE(cs.end_time, now()) AS end_time
  FROM charging_session cs
  WHERE cs.id_session::text = '${session:raw}'
)
SELECT a.date AS time, a.type, a.niveau_severite, a.status, a.message
FROM alerte a
LEFT JOIN capteur_data cd ON cd.id_data = a.id_data
LEFT JOIN capteur c ON c.id_capteur = cd.id_capteur
LEFT JOIN device d ON d.id_device = c.id_device
JOIN selected_session ss ON a.id_session = ss.id_session OR (d.id_emplacement = ss.id_emplacement AND a.date BETWEEN ss.start_time AND ss.end_time)
WHERE $__timeFilter(a.date)
ORDER BY a.date DESC
LIMIT 50;

list.definition:
SELECT cs.id_session::text AS __value, COALESCE(r.reference_code, '-') || ' - ' || s.nom || ' / ' || b.nom || ' / emplacement ' || e.numero::text || ' - ' || COALESCE(u.pseudo, 'utilisateur') AS __text
FROM charging_session cs
JOIN reservation r ON r.id_reservation = cs.id_reservation
LEFT JOIN utilisateur u ON u.id_user = r.id_user
JOIN emplacement e ON e.id_emplacement = cs.id_emplacement
JOIN borne b ON b.id_borne = e.id_borne
JOIN station s ON s.id_station = e.id_station
WHERE cs.end_time IS NULL OR cs.start_time >= now() - interval '24 hours'
ORDER BY cs.end_time IS NULL DESC, cs.start_time DESC
LIMIT 100;
